results.title: Solitude Seeker
results.description: Your hidden self-care need is QUALITY ALONE TIME. You recharge by being by yourself, away from noise and demands. For you, true rest means silence, stillness, and space to think. You don't need people to feel whole - your own company is enough. The next time you feel drained, don't force yourself to socialize. Instead, embrace the quiet. Cancel plans if you need to. Your soul is asking for peace, not parties.
results.description_zh: 你隐藏的自我关怀需求是高质量的独处时间。你通过远离噪音和要求的独处来恢复能量。对你来说，真正的休息意味着安静、静止和思考的空间。你不需要别人来让自己完整——你自己陪伴就足够了。下次当你感到疲惫时，不要强迫自己社交。相反，拥抱安静。如果需要的话，取消计划吧。你的灵魂需要的是平静，而不是派对。

results.title: Connection Crusader
results.description: Your hidden self-care need is GENUINE CONNECTION. You recharge through meaningful conversations and shared moments. Isolation doesn't restore you - it drains you. Your soul needs to feel seen, heard, and valued by others. The next time you're overwhelmed, reach out to someone you trust. A real conversation, even a short one, can reset your entire emotional state. You thrive when you belong.
results.description_zh: 你隐藏的自我关怀需求是真正的连接。你通过有意义的对话和共享时刻来恢复精力。独处不会让你恢复——它会让你枯竭。你的灵魂需要被他人看见、倾听和重视。下次当你感到不堪重负时，联系你信任的人吧。一场真正的对话，即使很短，也能重置你的整个情绪状态。当你有归属感时，你会茁壮成长。

results.title: Creative Nurturer
results.description: Your hidden self-care need is CREATIVE EXPRESSION. You recharge by making things with your hands - cooking, crafting, organizing, creating. Your mind needs an outlet, and physical activity keeps you grounded. When life feels chaotic, you need to DO something, not just think about it. The next time you feel lost, start a small project. Bake something, write something, build something. Creation is your therapy.
results.description_zh: 你隐藏的自我关怀需求是创造性的表达。你通过用手做事来恢复精力——烹饪、手工、整理、创造。你的心灵需要一个出口，而身体活动让你保持踏实。当生活感到混乱时，你需要做些什么，而不只是思考。下次当你感到迷茫时，开始一个小项目吧。烤点什么、写点什么、做点什么。创造是你的治疗方法。

results.title: Comfort Zone Dweller
results.description: Your hidden self-care need is NOSTALGIC COMFORT. You recharge by revisiting familiar, cozy things - old shows, childhood favorites, comfort foods. There's healing in what you know by heart. You don't need adventure right now; you need warmth and familiarity. The next time you feel fragile, don't force yourself to try something new. Rewatch that show. Eat that meal from home. Let yourself be held by what you know and love.
results.description_zh: 你隐藏的自我关怀需求是怀旧的安慰。你通过重温熟悉、舒适的事物来恢复精力——老节目、童年最爱、舒适的食物。发自内心的了解有治愈作用。你现在不需要冒险；你需要温暖和熟悉。下次当你感到脆弱时，不要强迫自己尝试新事物。重看那个节目。吃家里做的饭。让你自己被你了解和喜爱的事物所拥抱。
